# SmartSpace — Multi-University Facility Booking & Campus Resource Management SaaS

> Tagline: "Book It, Track It, Use It."
> Website: https://smartspace.ph/
> Last Updated: 2026-11-08

## Overview
SmartSpace is a multi-tenant higher education SaaS platform designed for university campuses across the Philippines and Southeast Asia. It digitizes physical facility management, eliminates paper booking forms, resolves scheduling conflicts in real-time, automates multi-tiered institutional approvals, and issues encrypted, time-bounded QR gate passes for campus security.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Conflict Prevention Engine**: Instant sub-second locking ensures zero overlapping reservations for high-demand campus venues (auditoriums, gymnasiums, sports courts, computer labs, lecture theaters, and seminar rooms).
- **Multi-Level Academic Approval Pipeline**: Department Chair, College Dean, Physical Plant & Facilities Director, and Campus Security verify booking requirements, clearances, and adviser endorsements systematically.
- **Encrypted Digital QR Gate Pass**: Approved bookings produce a scannable QR pass that guards and venue custodians verify on mobile devices at physical checkpoints.
- **Cross-University Booking**: Enables accredited student organizations and academic departments from partner universities to discover and reserve host campus venues with verified institutional clearance.
- **Centralized Facility Governance**: High-level utilization analytics, automated check-in compliance, equipment tracking, and incident logging for university administrations.

## Target Audience & User Roles
1. **Students & Student Organizations**: Browse available venues, submit reservation requests with event advisers, and receive digital gate passes.
2. **Faculty & Department Chairs**: Review college requests, reserve academic colloquium rooms, and approve syllabus-aligned workshops.
3. **University Facility Administrators**: Manage facility catalog, define advance reservation windows, enforce cleaning intervals, and monitor campus capacity.
4. **Campus Security & Building Custodians**: Scan QR gate passes at entry points, inspect attendance compliance, and log check-in/out timestamps.
5. **Super Administrators**: Manage institution tenants, system audit logs, and platform security.
